description lines: This database contains information about medications and users in a pharmacy system.
Each medication has details such as active ingredients, dosage instructions, prescription requirements, stock quantity, and price.
Users have unique IDs, names, and lists of active prescriptions.

medications.name: Acamol
medications.dosage_instructions: Adults: 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours. Do not exceed 8 tablets in 24 hours.

medications.name: Moxypen
medications.description: Antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections.
medications.dosage_instructions: 500mg every 8 hours. Complete the full course as prescribed.

medications.name: Lipitor
medications.description: Statin medication used to lower cholesterol.
medications.dosage_instructions: Take orally once daily at the same time each day.

medications.name: Ventolin Inhaler
medications.dosage_instructions: 1-2 puffs as needed for shortness of breath.
